turns.text: I'd like to practise a hard parent meeting. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. I'll send END MEETING on its own when I want to stop. I'm Owen's English teacher, and Meredith has just walked into my classroom.
Who decided Owen gets a zero, and why did he find out on his phone?
I spoke with the vice principal before you came in.
That isn't what I asked. And who else has seen this?
She's backing me completely. Policy is policy, and it isn't up to you.
Policy is policy. Then your own procedure, 4.2, says you call me before any mark goes in, and nobody did.
So frankly, this meeting is a courtesy.
A courtesy. Then I'll be in the principal's office when we're done, and I'll want the vice principal's position in writing.
